text:
claire-partnerships: Heads-up 1 - Aurora Hardware wants to go live in our cloud marketplace next week and asked us to ingest their compliance bundle: SOC3 (recent), a 3rd-party pen test, and SI integration artifacts. They want a single intake flow.

ben-platform: Can they presign a single package or do we want the separate components? We prefer separate so we can treat raw vs sanitized differently.

rita-legal: separate files + signed attestation required. We need the pen-tester's name, engagement date, scope, and a signed redaction statement. Also need a clause about downstream SI content.

ton y-sec: typo: tony-sec here. Security note: pen-test pdfs often include sensitive IP logs and customer hostnames. We require a manifest.sha256, a scope.txt, and a redaction log. Also request a tester contact and evidence of authorization.

ana-marketing: ping on embargo windows. Aurora expects announcement embargo until 2026-04-14. Need that in the intake manifest so we don't accidentally publish.

marketplace-bot: Upload checklist: evidence_ingest_v3 requires: attestation_signed.pdf, manifest.sha256, scope.txt, sanitized_assets.tar.gz, raw_archive (presigned, ttl 12h). Add field: contains_firmware=true/false.

claire-partnerships: Proposed flow: Aurora presigns two URLs: (1) raw-short-ttl for Redwood-sec team review, (2) sanitized for catalog ingestion. They sign attestation.pdf and include manifest with fields: filename, sha256, contains_firmware, press_embargo, pen_tester_name, pen_scope_dates. We'll run automated redaction for PII, but firmware diffs and binary blobs need manual check.

ben-platform: I can provide a tiny wrapper script we send to partners that validates manifest and uploads to presigned URL. Example:
```bash
# example presign + upload
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/aurora/raw-4967.tar.gz --expires-in 43200
curl -X PUT --data-binary @raw-4967.tar.gz "<presigned-url>"
```
I'll include validation: check manifest presence, run sha256 verify before accepting.

rita-legal: I'll add attestation template. Important: attestation must say whether SI integrator contributed any raw customer data in attachments. If yes, they must flag explicit consent and retention policy.

tony-sec: Let's schedule a 20min call with Aurora and their pen-test vendor to witness redaction process. I propose Wed 9am PT. Recording ok? we'll record for audit.

ana-marketing: please add embargo field so PM/marketing see it. Also ask Aurora if they want co-branded announcement or quiet listing.

marketplace-bot: Note: evidence intake ticket created #PART-4507. Retention policy: raw artifacts locked under partner-kms for 90 days, access logged; sanitized moved to catalog storage after sign-off.

claire-partnerships: Action owners: ben -> presign script + ingest hook + partner wrapper; rita -> attestation + legal clause for SI data; tony -> witness call + redaction checklist; ana -> confirm embargo/announce preference; me -> coordinate and run intake. Target: decision by Tue EOD, ingest Wed.

rita-legal: ack. I'll post template in #legal and ping Aurora for signed copy.

ben-platform: ack, will draft the wrapper and post in #devex.

tony-sec: ack, will set up call invite and include checklist.

marketplace-bot: Reminder: presigned links expiring < 24h require reissue; mark partner-managed artifacts to prevent auto-publish until legal sign-off.

claire-partnerships: Great. Keeping this thread as the source of truth for the intake. :white_check_mark:
